text: {"lessons":["I have repeatedly sold stocks after gains; I should not rush to lock in profits just for the satisfaction of realizing them, but weigh each position's prospects and my overall plan.","Avoiding the pain of admitting a mistake can keep me holding a weak position too long; I should reassess it objectively and sell when the reasons for owning it no longer hold.","I check and trade often, but frequent decisions can distract from long-term results; I should use clear rules for buying, holding, and selling rather than react to every price move."]}
